name: Distributed control systems and SCADA
principle: A DCS spreads control among autonomous controllers on a network, so one failure affects only part of a plant. SCADA adds supervisory computers, RTUs, PLCs and operator screens for geographically spread assets such as pipelines.

source.note: Wikipedia, Distributed control system, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

performance.basis: upper range quoted for ruggedised RTUs

limitations: Early SCADA systems used proprietary protocols and had little security
The pages give little oil-and-gas-specific detail
